## 🔬 Engineering Philosophy

<table align="center" width="100%" style="border: none;">
<tr>
<td width="70%" valign="top" style="border: none;">

I'm a Senior Fullstack Engineer who treats software the way a craftsman treats a blade — every layer forged with intent, nothing added that doesn't earn its place. Working daily inside a stripped-down **Fedora Linux** environment has shaped how I think: minimal surface area, maximal control.

I don't just write code that works — I design systems that *hold up*. Clean architecture, predictable state, and interfaces that feel effortless to the people using them. Off duty, I apply the same standard to advanced physical training: measured mechanics, disciplined repetition, zero wasted motion. That mindset carries straight into how I ship — deliberate, consistent, built to last.

> `"Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication — but only after you've earned it."`

</td>
<td width="30%" align="center" valign="top" style="border: none;">

<br/>
<sub><i>~ my debugging companion, powered by coffee ☕✨</i></sub>

</td>
</tr>
